kicker: THE LOSERS LEAGUE · SEASON 1 · DRAFT DAY
title: Draft Your Losers
dek: Build a team entirely out of people who lost. Your team plays all season: every issue of SIDE EYE scores every loser on this board.
summary: A fantasy league of history’s losers: draft board with salaries, scoring rules, a team card, the Vol. 1 box score and the editors’ own teams.

rows: Crossed the Alps with elephants. Beat Rome at home for fifteen years.
Two games in nineteen days, at opposite ends of England.
Comeback threat. Returned from Elba for a hundred days.
Richest man in Rome. Will try to buy the league.
Never crowned. Won the dynasty anyway.
Near 50 km/h in a sprint. Outlasted two machine guns.
1,123 seasons in one city. Insists it was Rome.
Held out three years under siege after handing over its weapons.
Deep roster. 130 ships, give or take.
Stats chiseled off by next owner.

Edison’s pick in the War of the Currents.
Lost to AC. Still in your phone charger.

items: 1. Draft: Fill all seven starting slots for $50 or less. Bench is optional. FLEX takes any RB, WR or TE.
2. Save: Fill in the team card on the next page. Cut it out or snap a photo. Rosters lock for the season.
3. Score: Every issue prints a League Box Score: points for every loser, based on what happens to them in that issue.
4. Win: Add it up on your card. The highest season total takes home the Sacko. In this league, that’s the trophy.

blocks.text: Bench players score half, rounded down. Toward the loser.
Waiver wire: Every issue adds new losers to the board. Drop one, add one, stay under $50.
Trades: Allowed. Good luck finding anyone who wants your losers.
Commissioners: Heather and Edwin. Rulings are final, unless one of them changes their mind.
